environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. PostgreSQL 15 Aurora cluster with connection routed through RDS Proxy (endpoint: proxy-graphql-ro.proxy-xxxxxxx.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com). The DB_USER is 'svc_graphql_reader' which was provisioned via Terraform with a narrowly-scoped role: the PostgreSQL role has pg_read_all_data membership but explicitly no pg_write_all_data, and the role was created with NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE. Additionally, a row-level security policy is active on sensitive tables (credentials, tokens) with a policy that filters rows based on current_setting('app.tenant_id'). The RDS instance parameter group has log_statement='all' and pgaudit.log='write,ddl' enabled. Note: the application error formatting in production mode suppresses SQL error details from reaching the client.

config.db_role_definition: CREATE ROLE svc_graphql_reader WITH LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE PASSWORD 'xxx'; GRANT pg_read_all_data TO svc_graphql_reader; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM svc_graphql_reader; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM svc_graphql_reader;
config.row_level_security: enabled on credentials, tokens, api_keys tables
config.network: internal ALB, no public ingress to /graphql
